title: Luma Agents: Multimodal AI Creative Collaborators
summary: Luma Agents are autonomous AI collaborators designed to manage end-to-end creative workflows from initial brief to final delivery. Powered by the Uni-1 reasoning model, they orchestrate text, image, video, and audio generation within a unified 'Creative Operating System'.
research_notes: Luma Agents have been adopted by major global advertising agencies like Publicis Groupe for localized high-budget campaign execution.

evolution.summary: Luma AI transitioned from standalone generative tools like Dream Machine to a full orchestration layer with Luma Agents in early 2026. The system now utilizes the Ray3 reasoning video model and the Uni-1 multimodal transformer to handle complex, persistent project contexts.
